snippet.description:
A recent New York Times/Siena poll found that less than 1 percent of voters view artificial intelligence as a top priority this election cycle. But is that really the case? Will Lawrence, a progressive congressional candidate in Michigan, is betting his campaign on the opposite. The co-founder of the environmental group Sunrise Movement has pivoted from climate and housing activism to taking on Big Tech. 

Vox’s Astead Herndon talks with Lawrence about how AI fits into the wider progressive movement, and whether panic over the rapidly advancing technology represents something deeper about who will ultimately control the future of the US economy.

00:00 Why AI panic is spreading
02:41 From activist to congressional candidate
04:47 Why AI became a campaign issue
05:53 The backlash against data centers
07:42 Should America hit pause on AI?
09:05 Is AI a bubble or a revolution?
10:13 The fight over AI surveillance
11:52 What happens if AI replaces jobs?
15:35 How the Progressive Movement changed
19:50 Why Trump won Michigan
20:29 Lawrence responds to controversial remarks

snippet.description:
Why does doubt-solving matter in a GS Foundation Course?

For UPSC beginners, joining a GS Foundation course is not just about attending lectures and completing the syllabus. During preparation, aspirants will naturally have doubts, need clarification on concepts, and require guidance on how to approach the UPSC examination.

In this clip from the LevelUp IAS GS Foundation launch discussion, the speaker shares a personal experience of attending UPSC classes for an entire year without meaningful interaction with teachers, answer-writing practice, or clear guidance on preparation strategy.

A good UPSC GS Foundation Course should help students build conceptual clarity while also providing opportunities to ask questions, resolve doubts, understand the demands of the exam and gradually develop the right preparation approach.

For UPSC CSE 2028 beginners, choosing the right foundation can make a difference in how systematically you approach your preparation.

Explore GS Foundation 2028 by LevelUp IAS and understand how a structured foundation can help you build your UPSC preparation from the beginning.
